about_the_game:
Welcome to the magical world of "Lucky Summoner," a strategic card battle game that combines deck building with RogueLite elements. Here, you'll play as a novice summoner who has just embarked on an adventure, using the power of cards to summon minions and enhance your combat prowess as you face off against a diverse array of enemies in battles of wit and courage. Your goal is to continuously strengthen yourself, ultimately passing the most challenging trial of the ultimate dragon to achieve the glory of becoming a legendary master summoner!

Combine strategy and tactics to build your own deck

The game's core gameplay revolves around strategy card battles. In each battle, you can summon powerful minions to fight for you by using cards in your hand, or use enhanced cards to increase their abilities and pose a greater threat to your enemies. With a well-designed turn-based mechanism, you need to plan every move properly, thinking about how to maximize damage or defense with limited resources. Every battle is full of suspense, and sometimes a simple decision can completely turn the tide of the battle.






Facing the Dragon's Trial, Triumph at the Summit Battle

At the end of your adventure awaits the ultimate Boss—the Dragon's Trial. The dragon, wielding devastating power, will be your greatest challenge. Only by utilizing all resources and wisdom gained throughout your journey can you stand undefeated before it. This is an intense battle to reach the summit, and also your final test as a Summoner.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7（SP1+）and above
  • Processor: x64 or x86
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1Gb Video Memory, capable of OpenGL 3.0+ support
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

short_description: Lucky Summoner is a deck-building Roguelite strategy card game.As a rookie summoner,use cards to summon or enhance minions,defeat enemies within limited turns.You can buy cards and relics to build unique decks.Grow stronger,face tougher opponents,and conquer the ultimate Dragon Trial.
